app_approval.title: Connect to Jung Home
app_approval.description: Confirm or enter the address of your Jung Home gateway. After you continue, approve the access request in the Jung Home app under Settings, Gateway, Access Permissions, Open Requests.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Jung Home gateway. It is filled in automatically when the gateway is discovered; otherwise replace the default junghome.local, which resolves only on some networks, with the gateway's IP address (for example 192.168.1.50).

password.title: Connect to Jung Home
password.description: Confirm the gateway address and enter its network-key password to connect immediately, without approving a request in the app. You can find the password in the Jung Home app.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Jung Home gateway. It is filled in automatically when the gateway is discovered; otherwise replace the default junghome.local, which resolves only on some networks, with the gateway's IP address (for example 192.168.1.50).
data_description.password: The Jung Home gateway network-key password.

register_failed.title: Registration failed
register_failed.description: The access request was not approved in time or the gateway could not be reached. Submit to try again, then approve the request in the Jung Home app under Settings, Gateway, Access Permissions, Open Requests.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthorize Jung Home
reauth_confirm.description: The gateway no longer accepts the stored access token. Approve the new access request in the Jung Home app under Settings, Gateway, Access Permissions, Open Requests.

reauth_failed.title: Reauthorization failed
reauth_failed.description: The access request was not approved in time or the gateway could not be reached. Submit to try again, then approve the request in the Jung Home app under Settings, Gateway, Access Permissions, Open Requests.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Jung Home
reconfigure.description: Update the address of your Jung Home gateway, for example after its IP address changed.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Jung Home gateway (for example 192.168.1.50).

reconfigure_certificate.title: Gateway certificate differs
reconfigure_certificate.description: The gateway at {host} presents a TLS certificate that differs from the one pinned for this entry (pinned {expected}, presented {observed}). This is expected only if the gateway was replaced or its storage was wiped or re-imaged; the certificate survives a factory reset and firmware updates. If none of that happened, another device may be answering at this address: go back and check the address instead. Nothing but a TLS handshake has been sent to it so far. Submit to trust the new certificate and continue.

init.title: Jung Home options
init.description: The poll interval sets how often the gateway is re-read over REST — live updates keep arriving over the WebSocket regardless, so a longer interval mainly reduces gateway load. Select any covers whose position is reported inverted, such as awnings. Their position is flipped so fully closed reads as 0 percent (closed) and fully open as 100 percent (open). Leave roller shutters and blinds unselected.

data_description.suppress_duplicate_presses: Current JUNG device firmware reports every tap twice. When enabled, a press on the same button within 1.2 seconds after a click is ignored, so each tap fires once. Turn this off only if your buttons report each tap once (older device firmware) and you need presses less than 1.2 seconds apart, for example double-clicks.

websocket_push_failure.title: Jung Home live updates have stopped
websocket_push_failure.description: Home Assistant has been unable to reconnect to the Jung Home gateway at {host} for several minutes ({failures} attempts in a row). Device states are no longer pushed instantly and now refresh only on the periodic REST poll. Check that the gateway is powered on and reachable on your network. This issue disappears on its own once the connection is restored.

confirm.title: Trust the gateway's new certificate
confirm.description: The device answering at {host} presents a TLS certificate ({observed}) that differs from the one Home Assistant pinned when it first connected to this Jung Home gateway ({expected}). Home Assistant has stopped talking to it, not even the access token is sent, and the gateway's entities stay unavailable until this is resolved. A changed certificate is expected only if the gateway was replaced or its storage was wiped or re-imaged; the certificate survives a factory reset and firmware updates. If none of that happened, another device may be answering at this address: do not confirm, check your network instead. Confirm that the Jung Home gateway at {host} was replaced or re-imaged and that the certificate it presents now ({observed}) should be trusted instead of the pinned one ({expected}). Home Assistant will pin the new certificate, send the access token to it and reconnect.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the gateway.
error.different_gateway: The address answers, but it belongs to a different Jung Home gateway than this entry. Use Reconfigure to change the address instead.

duplicate_device_labels.title: Jung Home devices with conflicting names

gateway_bluetooth_failure.title: Jung Home gateway Bluetooth failure
gateway_bluetooth_failure.description: The Jung Home gateway at {host} reports that its Bluetooth chip did not start, so it cannot reach your Jung Home devices. Restart the gateway by unplugging it briefly. If the problem persists, reset the gateway and add it to your project again in the Jung Home app. This issue disappears once the gateway has restarted without the error.

gateway_out_of_sequence_numbers.title: Jung Home gateway ran out of sequence numbers
gateway_out_of_sequence_numbers.description: The Jung Home gateway at {host} reports that it has run out of Bluetooth Mesh sequence numbers, so it may no longer be able to send commands to your Jung Home devices. If devices stop responding, reset the gateway and add it to your project again in the Jung Home app. This issue disappears once the gateway has restarted without the error.

gateway_time_sync_failure.title: Jung Home gateway clock is not synchronized
gateway_time_sync_failure.description: The Jung Home gateway at {host} has not been able to synchronize its clock with a time server for more than 24 hours. Check that the gateway has internet access. This issue disappears on its own once the clock is synchronized again.

gateway_project_missing.title: Jung Home gateway has no project
gateway_project_missing.description: The Jung Home gateway at {host} reports that it has not received the project from the Jung Home app, so it does not know your devices. Open the Jung Home app on the same local network as the gateway so it can upload the project again. This issue disappears once the gateway has received a new project.

gateway_project_incomplete.title: Jung Home gateway project is incomplete
gateway_project_incomplete.description: The Jung Home gateway at {host} reports that its project lacks device details, so device names, rooms and scenes may be missing or wrong. Synchronize the project manually in the Jung Home app. This issue disappears once the gateway has received a new project.
